data.body: CI run 33003670777 on rebased patch set 8 completed with deterministic lint/build failures: docs/env-vars.md was stale; src/rebar/llm/config.py was 803 LOC and runner.py 802 LOC. Regenerated the registry and moved existing stateless helpers along established seams (generic module detection to _optional.py; success run-shape capture to runner_support.py), preserving compatibility imports. Patch set 9 commit 9be2f80b321ade91e02103f4926f929c1ebc090b is uploaded; config.py is 794 LOC and runner.py 776 LOC. No local tests/gates were run per operator direction; fresh CI is authoritative.
